scope: Bounded source candidates only; reuse real Settings phone and MMS apps. No new HAP/SDK/Docker/QEMU build or runtime acceptance.

contract.modal_route: startAbilityByType(share) -> AMS query sysPicker/share -> com.ohos.settings/SharePickerExtensionAbility -> actual BMS enabled/exported sendData UIAbility enumeration -> user choice -> same action/MIME/URI BMS requery -> startAbilityAsCaller -> real selected receiver
contract.supported_payload: Flat WantParams type,uri,ability.params.stream,ability.subject; raw text or bounded file URI array. Native startAbilityByType moves ability.want.params.uriPermissionFlag into incoming Want.flags. File reads require caller READ; WRITE is never forwarded. Reserved/caller/component/account parameters are not forwarded.
contract.uri_authority: Native sessionInfo callerToken -> UpdateAsCallerInfoFromCallerRecord -> original caller token stored in Want -> SceneBoard ProcessForegroundAbility -> GrantUriPermission. Settings never opens/copies file or uses its own grant API. Host does not prove real permission enforcement; actual negative cases remain required.

results.selected: resultCode0,outcome=launched only after successful native start; selected component names returned; no claim of actual send/save/receipt
results.cancel: resultCode1,outcome=cancelled, no launch; also available during target query
results.return_retry: Same successful launch outcome retried without relaunch, even if user presses Cancel after an unsuccessful return

contract.receiver: MMS text/plain new skill -> actual validated text -> existing buildThirdParam -> real DynamicLoader(TransmitMsg) -> existing recipient/draft UI. No send API or arbitrary recipient injection. New Want invalidates stale async draft navigation.
